as I have changed the "message.key.columns": "public.users:customer_id", the expectation is on incremental snapshot I should get all records from users table, which has id as primary key, but it is just publishing 1 single record for a customer_id. e.g. If I have 100 users for 1 customerId, I'm just getting 1 record published to Kafka.
I'm running incremental snapshot by running a query like below:
INSERT INTO
    debezium_signal (id, type, data)
VALUES
    (
        uuid_generate_v4() :: varchar,
        'execute-snapshot',
        '{"data-collections": ["public.users"]}'
    );

evidence.quote: for the incremental snapshot we need to buffer chunk events to permit de-duplication... The key of the buffer is the record key, so in your case all record related to the same customer_id will case clash in the same key, only the last one will be retained.

notes: message.key.columns set to non-unique customer_id; incremental snapshot window dedups by record key, so only one row per key is emitted. Reporter did not confirm.
